A breve riceverai due mail: 1)Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2)Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. baseline.answer:
Hello,

To request creation of the **Data & Ai Practice** Team and obtain the ability to manage channels and members, please use the **MS Teams – Create or Rename a Team** service.

- If this is a **primary business project Team**, submit the request through the **Project Portal**: http://short.link/projectportal  
- If this is an **additional Team**, submit it through the relevant **iTop service request**.

Please include the following information in the request:

- Team scope: Global, Local, or Group (Italy)
- Client or internal department
- Whether client confidential data will be stored or processed
- Whether personal data will be stored beyond standard Teams data
- Whether external sharing is required
- Team classification
- Your L5-or-above manager for approval, unless you are L5 or above
- An additional Team Owner, if applicable
- The required channels, users, and the verified plugin/app you need to install

The requestor is added as a Team Owner by default. Please ensure client compliance if confidential client data will be processed.

Personal Data means any information relating to a natural person which can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person.

✔️ Only personnel from GHT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

Because you need recurring access to change environment variables and work with different Java/Maven versions, this must be submitted as a **Long-Term Local Administrator Rights (LAR)** request—not granted directly through this ticket.

Please complete the admin-rights request form with:

- Full name of your KLM employee manager at **L6 or above** for approval. If you are L6 or above, enter yourself as approver.
- Your computer’s **Device Name** (available in the Company Portal, or run `hostname` from Command Prompt).
- Computer system: **Windows**
- The clients/projects concerned.
- Justification: frequent changes to `JAVA_HOME`/path variables and `MAVEN_HOME`, and any required development software or installations.

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client contract requirements. Permanent LAR access is subject to approval, increases workstation security risk, and must be renewed after 12 months.

Regards,  
IT Support

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

query_description: Il tuo PC risulta obsoleto e fuori garanzia. Ti cambieremo il vecchio PC Service TAG LKMZQ27 con uno nuovo. Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG B7XH238 Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Milano. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1)Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2)Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://example.com/PolicyItaliane - Guide IT [help.example.com](https://example.com/GroupIT) L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG LKMZQ27 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG B7XH238 We will send you the new PC to the Milan office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy https://example.com/PolicyItaliane - IT Guides: [help.example.com](https://example.com/GroupIT) The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.

Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG 6DTY81F Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Milano. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1) Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2) Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://link.placeholder/policy.pdf - Guide IT https://link.placeholder/it-guides L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG 9XJ72M1 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG 6DTY81F We will send you the new PC to the Milano office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy https://link.placeholder/policy.pdf - IT Guides: https://link.placeholder/it-guides The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.

✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

Administrator rights must be requested through the **Local Administration Rights (LAR) request form**. Please complete the following information:

- Select **Long Term** if you require rights regularly for development and software installation; otherwise select **Temporary** for a one-time installation.
- Provide the full name of your GHF manager/approver at **level L6 or above**. If you are L6 or above, enter your own name.

- Specify your operating system.
- List the clients/projects you support.
- Provide a detailed justification and list the development software/actions requiring administrator rights.

Please first confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Rights are limited to approved, business-related software and must not be used to alter the base system or disable security controls. Approved rights require renewal after 12 months.
